summary.zh: 古镇的标志性建筑；传说中七宝之一的“氽来钟”就藏在这里。撞一声沉郁洪钟，悠远钟声回荡在蒲汇塘两岸。
summary.en: A historic landmark of the ancient town; legend says the Floating Bell, one of the seven ancient relics, rests inside. Strike the bronze bell and let its deep chime echo across both banks of Puhuitang River.

quote.zh: 氽来钟，飞来佛，金字莲花经，神树金鸡玉筷斧。
quote.en: Floating Bell, Flying Buddha, Golden Lotus Sutra, Sacred Tree, Golden Rooster, Jade Chopsticks and Axe.

summary.zh: 建于明正德十三年（1518年），已逾五百年历史。三孔石拱跨越蒲汇塘，南北大街以此为轴，形成了老街“非”字形的水乡格局。
summary.en: Built in 1518 during the Ming dynasty, this five-century-old three-arch stone bridge spans the Puhuitang River, forming the central axis that divides North and South Streets into a classic water-town layout.

quote.zh: 杨柳披烟看帆影如画，鸬鹚映雨听橹声似歌。
quote.en: Willows veiled in mist frame sails like a painting; cormorants in the rain echo with oars like a song.

summary.zh: 八仙桌、长条凳，一盆肉质细嫩的白切羊肉，配一杯老酒或热茶，是老街居民延续至今的生活方式；街巷里还有干蒸圆子等传统吃食。
summary.en: Around wooden Eight-Immortals tables and long benches, a plate of tender sliced mutton paired with local wine or hot tea remains a cherished daily ritual, alongside steamed glutinous dumplings and savory street fare.

quote.zh: 一碟白切羊肉配一盏热茶，在老街临河的木桌旁坐定，便是水乡清晨最踏实的日常。
quote.en: A plate of sliced mutton with a cup of hot tea by the riverside window is the most grounded morning ritual of the water town.

summary.zh: 铜模具烘出的海棠糕焦香温热，大锅沸水里翻滚的七宝汤圆与七宝方糕软糯甜润，串联起老街南大街代代相传的甜蜜记忆。
summary.en: Freshly baked Begonia cakes with caramelized crusts, alongside steaming Qibao glutinous rice balls and traditional square rice cakes, carry the enduring sweet memories of South Street through generations of visitors.

quote.zh: 蒸笼掀开时白雾升腾，现包现煮的汤团与方糕，裹着江南人岁时节令里的甜润期盼。
quote.en: When the bamboo steamer lifts in a cloud of white mist, freshly made rice cakes and tangyuan carry the sweet wishes of Jiangnan seasons.

author.zh: 南大街传统茶点风物志

summary.zh: 小铜勺作笔、温热糖浆作墨，转瞬间在石板上绘出游龙锦鲤；街巷间还汇聚了面塑、剪纸、龙凤字等非遗手艺与团扇手作体验。
summary.en: With a bronze ladle as a brush and molten sugar as ink, golden dragons and koi fish take shape on stone slabs, alongside dough modeling, paper cutting, calligraphy, and fan-painting crafts.

quote.zh: 以勺为笔、以糖为墨，手腕轻转间必须一气呵成，赶在糖丝冷却前定格龙凤麟羽。
quote.en: With a ladle as brush and molten sugar as ink, every stroke must flow in a single breath before the amber threads cool.

summary.zh: 老街上的七宝皮影艺术馆内，白绢幕后琴锣齐鸣，刻绘精巧的皮影人物在暖黄光影中腾挪起伏，演绎着水乡流传已久的民间故事。
summary.en: Inside the Qibao Shadow Puppet Museum on the old street, behind translucent silk screens and traditional gongs, finely carved leather figures dance in warm light to enact classic folk tales.

quote.zh: 一口道尽千古事，双手对舞百万兵。
quote.en: A single voice narrates a thousand years of tales; two hands command a million soldiers across the lit screen.

summary.zh: 老街旁是七宝万科广场、宝龙城与宝龙美术馆，传统水乡文脉与现代艺术展、潮流市集在此并置，展现出新潮好玩的闵行活力。
summary.en: Right beside the ancient town stand Qibao Vanke Plaza, Powerlong City, and Powerlong Art Museum, where contemporary exhibitions and vibrant markets meet historic waterways, showcasing the creative energy of Minhang.

quote.zh: 青瓦飞檐与当代美术馆隔街相望，千年古镇的慢时光与闵行新城区的活力在此自然相接。
quote.en: Grey-tiled eaves face contemporary art galleries across the street, where the unhurried pace of an ancient town meets the energy of modern Minhang.
